chapter: After the Paradise: club dates and Virginia
title: Wells' Chicken Shack in Harlem
summary: A restaurant known for chicken and waffles with a fine clientele; he led a quintet with Austin Powell for about a year and a half.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: What kind of a program was it? Was it similar at all to the Paradise?
No, it was different. It was a restaurant and he was highly respected in the

community for having good food, chicken and waffles. Yeah, that was his thing and he was a very sophisticated man and very cultured and he had a very fine clientele, you know, show people and, you know, people in the academic world. Anybody was subject to come in there, you know. They came in there for the food, then, after I came in there, then they started comin' and stayin' for the entertainment too, you know. Yeah.
So you were playing with a trio then?
No, it was a quartet. Yeah. Actually, it was a quintet 'cause it was three rhythm and Austin playin' guitar and me playin' saxophone, you know, so it was a quintet.
And then that lasted for a year...
